facts.text: Incoming first-year students who are New Jersey residents with an annual household adjusted gross income from $0 to $65,000 can receive tuition coverage through the Felician Promise.

sources.title: Felician Promise Policy and Procedure
sources.quote: Incoming first-year students starting the Fall 2026 semester enrolled in a traditional undergraduate program. New Jersey Resident. United States Citizen or Permanent Resident. Have an annual household adjusted gross income (AGI) from $0 to $65,000.
